title: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) allows an unauthorized attacker to… (CVE-2026-85897)
description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability exists in Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) that allows an unauthorized attacker to execute code remotely over a network. The flaw has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.8, indicating critical impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability. No affected versions or patch information are currently provided.
